metadata.title: Faint, high proper motion star candidates selected from the SDSS and PS1 catalogs

notes: No individual star is explicitly identified as a Galactic unbound candidate. The paper presents 2,923 anonymous high-proper-motion candidates, and its discussion only suggests that the list may contain hypervelocity-star candidates; the roughly 30 high-velocity cases are not individually identified and are not retained as reliable unbound candidates because of possible Gaia parallax errors (T:p4-b3). High proper motion or a possible hypervelocity designation alone does not establish Galactic unbound candidacy under the stated rules.
